## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` and `npm test` pass (CI runs them too)
- [ ] Tested at desktop width and at 400 px, console clean
- [ ] Keyboard works, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Explanations follow `docs/WRITING.md`, and the level on the card is honest
- [ ] Numbers are hedged, schematic visuals are labelled, invented data is marked
- [ ] Original work, third-party material credited with its licence
- [ ] `topics.json`, the `README.md` table, the preview and the share card added (new topics)
- [ ] If `shared/` changed: every topic in the affected category was checked at desktop and phone width
